// CASE braceless_if_return expect=pass
Future<int> e1(int n) async {
  for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) if (await isFree(i)) return i;
  return -1;
}

// CASE braced_if_return_control expect=pass
Future<int> e3(int n) async {
  for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    if (await isFree(i)) return i;
  }
  return -1;
}

// CASE braced_try_return expect=pass
Future<String> e9(List<String> urls) async {
  Object? last;
  for (var i = 0; i < urls.length; i++) {
    try {
      return await fetchOne(urls[i]);
    } catch (e) {
      last = e;
    }
  }
  throw last!;
}

// CASE retry_attempt_sleep expect=pass
Future<void> e10() async {
  for (var attempt = 1; attempt <= 3; attempt++) {
    if (await tryOnce()) return;
    await Future<void>.delayed(const Duration(seconds: 1));
  }
}
